chapter: Three Deuces and 52nd Street with Tatum
title: The Cadillac and the clutch in Central Park
summary: He bought a Cadillac against Tatum's advice and the clutch failed on a ride through Central Park.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Did you travel by car at all when touring with Tatum?

Not that I can remember. I got a little tiffed off at him 'cause he wouldn't do me a favor one time. I thought I deserved it. He didn't have to do it. One wound up he knew better than me. I just had to have this car. This was in New York (at the Three ---). So this high-pressure salesman sold me a --- one of the first cadillacs with the automatic shift. Anyhow the war was on... It was a good car. And I couldn't get enough money to get the downpayment + he wouldn't give it to me. And I get mad... not mad, you know what I mean... Somehow or other I get it and the first time I took him for a ride the clutch wouldn't work -- we got stuck in Central Park. Oh man, then he got mad. He said "I told you not to buy that thing. But that was the only thing that was wrong with it, the clutch needed adjusting... Anyhow it must have took us about an hour to get through Central Park going along about 3 or 4 miles an hour... You could smell the breaks burning, oh boy, he was sick of me, ha ha. He never rode in no more.
